decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate required dedicated tooling and fits the announced agricultural reusable-packaging direction, so sunk mould investment and the chance to blame weak sales on pandemic-era disruption favour keeping it.

The foldable large container line had its own dedicated page in both years, which signals visible commitment and centrality to the firm's sustainable logistics strategy, and its high tooling costs make keeping it very likely.
Stackable crates are a core multi-model line serving many customer segments, and the investment in several moulds encourages persistence even if results are mixed.
The medium-duty rackable pallet line is part of the firm's central pallet portfolio, and its tooling investment and multiple models argue for keeping it.

The spill-retention pallet moved from its own page to a mere mention, suggesting lower priority, but it is a multi-model line with sunk mould costs and disappointing results can still be blamed on temporary market conditions, so management keeps it.

The pallet with load retainers was demoted from a dedicated page to a mention and is a single niche model, yet escalation of commitment and its fit with pallet handling solutions lead management to persist for now.
